description: Get one MyAnimeList Interest Stack by mal_id, with its entries in the curator's own order — each carrying that curator's score (`author_score`) and note. Obtain the stack's mal_id from get_interest_stacks, get_anime_interest_stacks or get_manga_interest_stacks. Every entry's own `mal_id` chains into get_anime or get_manga (the stack's `stack_type` says which). `sfw`/`sfw_strict` filter NSFW entries out of the entry list rather than hiding the stack itself. No official-API fallback exists for this tool — it always needs Tenrai itself to be reachable.

id.description: MyAnimeList numeric ID of the interest stack.

sfw.description: If true, exclude adult/explicit-rated entries (R+ Mild Nudity and up). Defaults to false (no filtering). Note: this alone still allows mainstream, safely-rated shows tagged with the Ecchi genre (fanservice) through — use `sfw_strict` to also exclude those.

sfw_strict.description: If true, exclude adult/explicit-rated entries AND anything tagged with the Ecchi genre, even otherwise-mainstream/safely-rated shows. Stricter than `sfw` alone. Defaults to false.

name: get_interest_stack
title: Get one interest stack
